ha20.name: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20)
ha20.definition: the autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous germline TNFAIP3 loss-of-function variants
not_this_disease: somatic TNFAIP3 variants in lymphoma or other cancers
TNFAIP3 polymorphisms in association studies (lupus, rheumatoid arthritis and others) without individual patients with a germline variant presented as causing their disease
ha20._source: written by Claude for the D-47 addendum on 2026-11-14 (HA20 is not in configs/diseases.yaml: its pilot corpus was not full-text screened)

axd.name: Alexander disease
axd.definition: the leukodystrophy caused by heterozygous (usually de novo) GFAP variants
not_this_disease: GFAP used as an astrocyte or glial marker (immunostaining, gliosis, tumours)
serum or CSF GFAP as a biomarker of brain injury, stroke, multiple sclerosis or neurodegeneration
autoimmune GFAP astrocytopathy (anti-GFAP antibodies), which is a different disease
other leukodystrophies without a GFAP variant
axd.query: ("Alexander disease"[tiab] OR "Alexander's disease"[tiab] OR "Alexander Disease"[MeSH] OR (GFAP[tiab] AND (leukodystroph*[tiab] OR leukoencephalopath*[tiab])))

lad1.name: leukocyte adhesion deficiency type I (LAD-I)
lad1.definition: the primary immunodeficiency caused by biallelic ITGB2 variants (CD18 deficiency)
not_this_disease: LAD type II (SLC35C1) or LAD type III (FERMT3/kindlin-3); a paper on these is "no" unless it also describes LAD-I patients
ITGB2/CD18 biology, integrin signalling or leukocyte trafficking without patients
ITGB2 expression in cancer or common-disease association studies
lad1.query: ("leukocyte adhesion deficiency"[tiab] OR "leucocyte adhesion deficiency"[tiab] OR "Leukocyte-Adhesion Deficiency Syndrome"[MeSH] OR "CD18 deficiency"[tiab] OR ITGB2[tiab] OR ITGB2[Gene Name])

ssadh.name: succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase (SSADH) deficiency
ssadh.definition: the neurometabolic disorder caused by biallelic ALDH5A1 variants (4-hydroxybutyric aciduria)
not_this_disease: GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyrate) drug use, intoxication or treatment of narcolepsy or alcohol dependence
ALDH5A1 polymorphisms in association studies without SSADH-deficient patients
animal models (Aldh5a1 knockout mice) with no patients
ssadh.query: ("succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency"[tiab] OR "SSADH deficiency"[tiab] OR SSADHD[tiab] OR "4-hydroxybutyric aciduria"[tiab] OR "gamma-hydroxybutyric aciduria"[tiab] OR "4-hydroxybutyricaciduria"[tiab] OR ALDH5A1[tiab] OR ALDH5A1[Gene Name])

tangier.name: Tangier disease
tangier.definition: the near-absence of HDL caused by biallelic ABCA1 variants
not_this_disease: ABCA1 polymorphisms or expression in association studies of lipids, coronary disease, diabetes or Alzheimer disease, without individual patients
tangier.unclear_note: heterozygous ABCA1 carriers with familial HDL deficiency (not Tangier disease) are "unclear", so the full text decides
tangier.query: ("Tangier disease"[tiab] OR "Tangier Disease"[MeSH] OR "analphalipoproteinemia"[tiab] OR (ABCA1[tiab] AND ("HDL deficiency"[tiab] OR hypoalphalipoproteinemia[tiab] OR "low HDL"[tiab])))
